description_en: Queries the list of authorized users for a specified delivery group or delivery group set by using paging. Supports exact or fuzzy filtering by username
description_zh: 分页查询指定交付组或交付组集合已授权的用户列表，支持按用户名精确或模糊筛选
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center list-authorized-users --product-type CloudBrowser --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --app-instance-group-id big-3jm9d0abc00example --app-instance-group-set-id set-3jm9d0abc00example --app-id - --end-user-id alice --user-id-fuzzy ali --app-instance-persistent-id ai-3jm9d0abc00example --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAuthorizedUsers

parameters.help_en:
The product type. The value must match the product type of the queried delivery group or delivery group set. If the value does not match, a resource-not-found error code is returned.

Valid values:

CloudApp: Wuying Cloud Application.
CloudBrowser: Cloud Browser.
WuyingServer: Enterprise Edition Workstation.
WuyingWorkstation: Personal Edition Linggou Container Workstation.
WuyingWorkstationTeam: Linggou Team Edition Container Workstation.
WuyingWorkstationBusiness: Linggou Dedicated Edition Container Workstation.
AndroidCloud: Cloud Phone.
AIAgent: AgentBay (AI agent)
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。取值需与被查询交付组或交付组集合的产品类型一致，不一致时返回资源不存在错误码。

取值：

CloudApp：无影云应用。
CloudBrowser：云浏览器。
WuyingServer：企业版工作站。
WuyingWorkstation：个人版灵构容器工作站。
WuyingWorkstationTeam：灵构团队版容器工作站。
WuyingWorkstationBusiness：灵构专属版容器工作站。
AndroidCloud：云手机。
AIAgent：AgentBay（AI 智能体）
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of records per page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

When the authorization mode is `App` or `AppInstanceGroup`, pagination is based on authorization records. Multiple authorization records for the same user are merged into a single user entry. Therefore, the actual number of users returned on the current page may be less than this value
parameters.help_zh:
每页返回的记录数。取值范围：1~100。

授权模式为 `App` 或 `AppInstanceGroup` 时按授权记录分页，同一用户的多条授权记录会合并为一个用户返回，因此当前页实际返回的用户数可能少于该值
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh: 查询页码，从第 1 页开始
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The delivery group ID. Call the [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) operation to obtain this value. For cloud browser groups, specify the browser group ID returned by the [ListBrowserInstanceGroup](~~ListBrowserInstanceGroup~~) operation.

Exactly one of this parameter and AppInstanceGroupSetId must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
交付组 ID。可调用 [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) 接口获取；云浏览器组请填写 [ListBrowserInstanceGroup](~~ListBrowserInstanceGroup~~) 接口返回的浏览器组 ID。

与 AppInstanceGroupSetId 必须且只能传入一个
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The delivery group set ID.

Exactly one of this parameter and AppInstanceGroupId must be specified. When querying by set, do not specify AppId or AppInstancePersistentId. Otherwise, a parameter error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
交付组集合 ID。

与 AppInstanceGroupId 必须且只能传入一个。 按集合查询时，请勿传入 AppId 和 AppInstancePersistentId，否则返回参数错误
parameters.name: app_instance_group_set_id

parameters.help_en:
The application ID. Specifies the application to filter users who are authorized for that specific application (authorized through the [AuthorizeUsersForApp](~~AuthorizeUsersForApp~~) operation). This parameter applies to delivery groups with the `App` authorization mode. Obtain the application ID from the Apps list returned by the [GetAppInstanceGroup](~~GetAppInstanceGroup~~) operation.

If not specified, all authorized users under the delivery group are returned. This parameter is not supported when querying by delivery group set
parameters.help_zh:
应用 ID，用于筛选针对该应用单独授权（通过 [AuthorizeUsersForApp](~~AuthorizeUsersForApp~~) 接口授权）的用户。适用于授权模式为 `App` 的交付组，应用 ID 可通过 [GetAppInstanceGroup](~~GetAppInstanceGroup~~) 接口返回的 Apps 列表获取。

不传入时，返回该交付组下的全部授权用户。按交付组集合查询时不支持该参数
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The username for exact matching. If not specified, no filtering by exact username is applied. Can be specified together with UserIdFuzzy, in which case both conditions must be met
parameters.help_zh: 用户名，按用户名精确匹配。不传入时不按完整用户名筛选。可与 UserIdFuzzy 同时传入，此时需同时满足
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The username keyword for fuzzy matching. A match occurs if the username contains this keyword. For example, if you specify `ali`, both `alice` and `ali.wang` are returned. If not specified, no keyword-based filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 用户名关键字，按用户名模糊匹配，用户名中包含该关键字即命中。例如填写 `ali`，则 `alice`、`ali.wang` 都会被查询到。不传入时不按关键字筛选
parameters.name: user_id_fuzzy

parameters.help_en:
The persistent session ID. Specifies the persistent session to filter users who are granted that session. This parameter applies to delivery groups with the `Session` authorization mode. Call the [ListPersistentAppInstances](~~ListPersistentAppInstances~~) operation to obtain this value.

If specified, only users granted that session are returned. However, the response parameter AppInstancePersistentIds still lists all persistent sessions granted to each user. This parameter is not supported when querying by delivery group set
parameters.help_zh:
持久会话 ID，用于筛选获授该持久会话的用户。适用于授权模式为 `Session` 的交付组，可调用 [ListPersistentAppInstances](~~ListPersistentAppInstances~~) 接口获取。

传入时仅返回获授该会话的用户，但返回参数 AppInstancePersistentIds 仍会列出该用户获授的全部持久会话。按交付组集合查询时不支持该参数
parameters.name: app_instance_persistent_id

schema.description_en: The paging result of the authorization user query
schema.description_zh: 授权用户分页查询结果

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number, which is the same as the PageNumber request parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页码，与请求参数 PageNumber 一致

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page, which is the same as the PageSize request parameter
PageSize.description_zh: 每页记录数，与请求参数 PageSize 一致

TotalCount.description_en:
The total number of records that match the query conditions. Use this value to determine whether to continue paging.

When the authorization mode is `App` or `AppInstanceGroup`, this is the number of authorization records. If the same user has multiple authorization records, the user is counted multiple times. Therefore, this value may be greater than the actual number of users.
When the authorization mode is `Session`, this is the deduplicated user count
TotalCount.description_zh:
符合查询条件的记录总数，用于判断是否继续翻页。

授权模式为 `App` 或 `AppInstanceGroup` 时，为授权记录数；同一用户有多条授权记录时会计入多次，因此可能大于实际用户数。
授权模式为 `Session` 时，为去重后的用户数

Users.description_en: The list of authorized users on the current page. Multiple authorization records for the same user are merged into a single entry. An empty list is returned if no authorized users match the conditions
Users.description_zh: 当前页的授权用户列表。同一用户的多条授权记录合并为一项返回；没有符合条件的授权用户时为空列表

items.description_en: The information about an authorized user

AccountType.description_en:
The account type of the user. Valid values:

simple: Convenience account.
ad: Active Directory (AD) domain account, which originates from an enterprise AD domain
AccountType.description_zh:
用户的账号类型。取值：

simple：便捷账号。
ad：AD 域账号，来自企业 AD 域的账号

AppId.description_en: The application ID. Returned only when AppId is specified in the request. The value is the same as the request parameter. Not returned if AppId is not specified or when querying by delivery group set
AppId.description_zh: 应用 ID。仅在请求传入 AppId 时返回，取值与请求参数一致；未传入 AppId 或按交付组集合查询时不返回
AppId.title_en:
应用ID。
当AuthMode为App且IsAuthAllApps=false，该字段才有值。
AppId.title_zh:
应用ID。
当AuthMode为App且IsAuthAllApps=false，该字段才有值。

AppInstanceGroupId.description_en: The delivery group ID associated with the user's authorization relationship. When querying by delivery group, this value is the same as the request parameter. When querying by delivery group set, this value is the primary delivery group ID of the set
AppInstanceGroupId.description_zh: 用户所属授权关系的交付组 ID。按交付组查询时与请求参数一致；按交付组集合查询时为该集合的主交付组 ID

AppInstanceGroupSetId.description_en: The delivery group set ID. Returned only when querying by delivery group set. The value is the same as the AppInstanceGroupSetId request parameter
AppInstanceGroupSetId.description_zh: 交付组集合 ID。仅在按交付组集合查询时返回，取值与请求参数 AppInstanceGroupSetId 一致

AppInstancePersistentIds.description_en: The list of persistent session IDs granted to the user. Returned only when the delivery group authorization mode (AuthMode) is `Session`. This list is not affected by the AppInstancePersistentId request parameter and always includes all persistent sessions granted to the user
AppInstancePersistentIds.description_zh: 该用户获授的持久会话 ID 列表。仅在交付组授权模式（AuthMode）为 `Session` 时返回，且不受请求参数 AppInstancePersistentId 的筛选影响，始终列出该用户获授的全部持久会话
AppInstancePersistentIds.title_en:
授权的持久会话ID列表。
当AuthMode为Session时，该字段才有值。
AppInstancePersistentIds.title_zh:
授权的持久会话ID列表。
当AuthMode为Session时，该字段才有值。

AuthMode.description_en:
The authorization mode of the delivery group, which determines the scope of results returned by this operation. Valid values:

App: Application-level authorization. Applications within the delivery group are authorized to users without restricting which sessions the users can use.
Session: Session-level authorization. Persistent sessions within the delivery group are authorized to users without restricting which applications the users can use. In this case, AppInstancePersistentIds returns the persistent sessions granted to the user.
AppInstanceGroup: Delivery group-level authorization. The entire delivery group is authorized to users, allowing them to open any application using any session within the delivery group.

When querying by delivery group set, the authorization mode of the primary delivery group in the set is returned
AuthMode.description_zh:
交付组的授权模式，决定本接口的返回范围。取值：

App：应用授权。将交付组下的应用授权给用户，不限制用户使用哪些会话。
Session：会话授权。将交付组下的持久会话授权给用户，不限制用户使用哪些应用；此时 AppInstancePersistentIds 返回用户获授的持久会话。
AppInstanceGroup：交付组授权。将整个交付组授权给用户，用户可使用交付组下的任意会话打开任意应用。

按交付组集合查询时，返回该集合主交付组的授权模式

Email.description_en: The email address of the user. Returned only when the account information of the user can be retrieved
Email.description_zh: 用户邮箱。仅在能获取到该用户的账号信息时返回

EndUserId.description_en: The username. To remove authorization, pass this value to the UnAuthorizeUserIds parameter of the [AuthorizeInstanceGroup](~~AuthorizeInstanceGroup~~) or [AuthorizeUsersForApp](~~AuthorizeUsersForApp~~) operation
EndUserId.description_zh: 用户名。移除授权时，可将该值传入 [AuthorizeInstanceGroup](~~AuthorizeInstanceGroup~~) 或 [AuthorizeUsersForApp](~~AuthorizeUsersForApp~~) 接口的 UnAuthorizeUserIds 参数

IsAuthAllApps.description_en:
Indicates whether the query is not restricted to a specific application. Valid values:

true: AppId is not specified in the request. All authorized users under the delivery group are returned.
false: AppId is specified in the request. Only users authorized for that specific application are returned.

This field is determined by whether the AppId request parameter is specified. It does not reflect the actual scope of applications authorized to the user and cannot be used to determine whether the user is authorized for all applications
IsAuthAllApps.description_zh:
本次查询是否未限定具体应用。取值：

true：请求未传入 AppId，返回的是交付组下的全部授权用户。
false：请求传入了 AppId，返回的是针对该应用单独授权的用户。

该字段由请求参数 AppId 是否传入决定，与用户实际被授权的应用范围无关，不能据此判断用户是否获授全部应用

Phone.description_en: The phone number of the user. Returned only when the account information of the user can be retrieved
Phone.description_zh: 用户手机号码。仅在能获取到该用户的账号信息时返回
